summary.text: Amy Slavensky is the Democratic candidate for California State Assembly District 7 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Josh Hoover.
Her campaign website describes her as a former educator raised in Fair Oaks and Carmichael.

paragraphs.text: Amy Slavensky says on her campaign website that she was raised in Fair Oaks and Carmichael, grew up on food stamps and Medi-Cal, lived in subsidized housing, put herself through college and supported her family on an educator's salary.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary.

Her stated priorities are bringing down the cost of food and gas, making affordable housing easier to find, providing quality and affordable healthcare, and ensuring quality education for all students.
